import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Survival Rate by Class and Sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_data = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_data.pivot(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived')
class_order = ['First', 'Second', 'Third']
survival_pivot = survival_pivot.reindex(class_order)
x = np.arange(len(class_order))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax1.bar(x - width/2, survival_pivot['female'], width, label='Female', color='#FF6B6B', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax1.bar(x + width/2, survival_pivot['male'], width, label='Male', color='#4ECDC4', alpha=0.8)
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels(class_order)
ax1.legend(frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Age Distribution by Survival
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#E74C3C', '#2ECC71'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Survival Rate by Embarkation Port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
embark_survival['rate'] = embark_survival['sum'] / embark_survival['count']
embark_labels = {'S': 'Southampton', 'C': 'Cherbourg', 'Q': 'Queenstown'}
embark_names = [embark_labels.get(idx, idx) for idx in embark_survival.index if pd.notna(idx)]
embark_rates = [embark_survival.loc[idx, 'rate'] for idx in embark_survival.index if pd.notna(idx)]
embark_counts = [embark_survival.loc[idx, 'count'] for idx in embark_survival.index if pd.notna(idx)]
colors = ['#3498DB', '#9B59B6', '#F39C12']
bars = ax3.bar(embark_names, embark_rates, color=colors, alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black')
for bar, count in zip(bars, embark_counts):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.02,
             f'n={count}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xlabel('Port of Embarkation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax3.set_ylim(0, 0.7)

# 4. Fare vs Age scatter plot colored by survival
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
survived_df = df[df['survived'] == 1]
died_df = df[df['survived'] == 0]
ax4.scatter(died_df['age'], died_df['fare'], alpha=0.5, s=30, 
           c='#E74C3C', label='Died', edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax4.scatter(survived_df['age'], survived_df['fare'], alpha=0.6, s=30, 
           c='#2ECC71', label='Survived', edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Fare vs Age by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax4.set_ylim(0, 300)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
